description_full:
We’re Hiring: Graphic Designer Intern!

Jakarta, Indonesia (WFO)

At Peepl, we are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer Intern who is eager to gain hands-on experience in graphic design.

You will work closely with our design team on various projects, learn directly from experienced professionals, and have the opportunity to develop your skills and build a professional portfolio.

Fresh graduate or final-year student in Graphic Design, Visual Communication Design, or a related field

Proficient in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and Canva

Portfolio showcasing creativity, attention to detail, and illustration skills

Able to create digital and/or manual illustrations

Familiarity with Krita or After Effects is a plus

Willing to learn, explore new ideas, and collaborate with the team
